en.headline: Butter Bar opens in Sai Kung focusing on flavoured butters and sourdough
en.dek: The café at Dock 1A begins soft opening on 16 November, offering eight butter varieties with toast from a team linked to Clean Taps.
body: Butter Bar starts soft opening on Monday at Shop G2, Ground Floor, Dock 1A, 1A Chui Tong Road in Sai Kung. The café centres on flavoured butters served with thick-cut sourdough toast.

The team behind Clean Taps, which previously operated a coffee bar and laundromat in Sheung Wan, developed the concept. Butter varieties were created with Chun Wah Leung, executive chef at the Michelin-starred Racines. The current selection includes a house butter with applewood smoke notes, plus seasonal options such as honey and mustard, spicy fuyu, matcha and nori, nai jeung toast, mocha, lava custard, and lemon and basil.

Menu items include single butters with toast, a three-butter flight, toasted sandwiches, pastries and coffee. Self-serve taps provide black coffee, lemon tea and Hong Kong-style milk tea. The space holds a general restaurant licence and is described by the operators as a neighbourhood café.

zh.headline: 西貢Butter Bar今日軟開幕 主打風味牛油配酸種多士
zh.dek: 位於Dock 1A的咖啡館由Clean Taps團隊經營，提供八款牛油，包括招牌蘋果木煙燻口味。
body: Butter Bar於周一在西貢翠塘路1A號Dock 1A地下G2舖開始軟開幕。店舖以風味牛油配厚切酸種多士為主打。
經營團隊來自上環Clean Taps，曾經營咖啡吧及自助洗衣店。牛油由米芝蓮星級餐廳Racines行政主廚梁俊華共同研發。現有選擇包括帶蘋果木煙燻風味的招牌牛油，以及蜜糖芥末、辣腐乳、抹茶紫菜、奶醬多、摩卡、流沙包及檸檬羅勒等季節口味。
餐牌有單款牛油配多士、三款牛油拼盤、烤三文治、糕點及咖啡。自助水龍頭提供黑咖啡、檸檬茶及港式奶茶。店舖持有普通食肆牌照，經營者形容為鄰里咖啡館。
